title: Portal Skein: Navigation rewrite for multi-tenant console (sidebar, routing, workspace pivot)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Rewrite of Console information architecture to support fast role-aware routing, progressive workspace pivots, and consolidated access to Dashboards, Rollouts, and Cost views. The goal is a topology that reduces time-to-route for critical tasks (incidents, rollbacks, cost spikes) while supporting multi-tenant workspaces and platform consistency across Hosted/Dedicated/Private modes. Deliverables: IA diagram, high-fidelity Figma prototypes (expanded + compact), keyboard-first nav spec, accessibility checklist, and handoff tokens for frontend implementation.
comments: 2025-11-04 - MC: Kickoff meeting notes saved to Confluence (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Portal+Skein+Kickoff). Agreed success metrics: reduce avg route time for critical flows by 25%, increase rollouts discoverability, and surface per-route cost quickly.

2025-11-07 - AR: Initial IA draft uploaded to Figma (https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/portal-skein-ia). Focus areas: persistent micro-workspace chip, route prioritization rules, and a compact sidebar variant for narrow screens.

2025-11-10 - PM (Rajan Singh): Feedback - ensure rollout controls (canary/A-B/auto-fallback) remain accessible from primary nav and from per-model dashboards. Please add deep-link schema for programmatic routing.

2025-11-12 - ENG (Sofia Petrov): Technical constraints: Private deployments can't rely on cloud-region routing metadata. Suggest including an opt-in local routing flag on workspace config. Also flagged risk with lazy-loaded icon fonts; prefer inline svgs for fast first-paint.

2025-11-13 - MC: Usability study plan added to comments. 6 participants (2 platform PMs, 2 infra SREs, 2 product engineers). Study will measure task completion time for: (1) open model rollout, (2) view last 24h cost by route, (3) switch active workspace and continue interrupted session.

2025-11-14 - Figma review: design team iterated micro-workspace chip (hover reveals recent routes + quick switch). Prototype link: https://www.figma.com/proto/def456/portal-skein-proto. Notes: chip must show role badge when user has role-based access differences.
2025-11-16 - Design critique: PM & Eng both approved IA shape; asked to produce a keyboard-first nav spec and include ARIA landmarks. Action: create nav-keyboard-spec (estimate 3 points).

2025-11-18 - AR: Implementable tokens and a component map delivered. Frontend engineer pairing scheduled for 2025-11-24. GitHub RFC created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/112 (nav-routing-prioritization).

2025-11-19 - MC: Usability pilot with 3 participants. Early findings: persistent chip helped reduce workspace-switch latency by ~18% but participants expected the cost summary to appear in the top-right quick glimpse; moving cost toggle up improved discoverability. Added follow-up task to refine quick glance affordance.
2025-11-20 - PM (Rajan): Request to include rollout status badge in sidebar for any route with active canary. Added as label 'rollout-badge' to spec and included in engineering handoff.
Open items: keyboard nav spec, private deployment routing flag documented, accessibility audit, production rollout plan with A/B measurement, and integration tests for deep-link routing.
